controls.objective: Bind every deployment attempt to reviewed candidate and previous full commit IDs with preserved release artifacts.
controls.release_verification: Record both full commit IDs, image digests, operator, and maintenance window from clean protected release directories on the selected VM.

controls.objective: Review the exact migration plan and classify forward-schema compatibility before service interruption.
controls.release_verification: Retain a sanitized classification for every candidate migration and abort when backward compatibility is not proven.

controls.objective: Write and verify signed audit checkpoints and an encrypted snapshot before applying candidate migrations.
controls.release_verification: Verify the off-VM snapshot, release marker, external checkpoints, and available clean restore capacity immediately before cutover.

controls.objective: Apply schema changes only with the dedicated migration identity while runtime and verification identities retain narrower privileges.
controls.release_verification: Confirm the rendered release configuration uses the migration role for schema changes and the runtime role cannot alter schema.

controls.objective: Require candidate health, fixture integrity, audit chains, signed checkpoints, and exact candidate schema state after migration.
controls.release_verification: Run approved-device login and read-only financial, audit, checkpoint, and sanitized-log checks on the selected candidate.

controls.objective: Start the preserved previous application against the forward schema only after explicit compatibility proof and without reversing migrations.
controls.release_verification: Prove the actual previous release artifact remains healthy against the candidate schema or select clean-database rollback.

controls.objective: Restore the pre-upgrade snapshot into a new protected database, reject live or existing targets, and prove candidate schema is absent.
controls.release_verification: Time a clean restore from the real off-VM snapshot and start the preserved previous artifact on the verified replacement database.

controls.objective: Record release IDs, snapshot and checkpoint references, timings, outcomes, and finding IDs without secrets or household data.
controls.release_verification: Bind the clean-VM result and observed recovery time to the exact candidate while retaining raw transcripts only in encrypted assessment storage.

success_markers: Disposable forward-upgrade and clean-database rollback rehearsal completed.
rehearsal.limitation: The disposable rehearsal uses one source tree and synthetic data; clean-VM validation still requires two preserved release artifacts, private TLS, approved devices, off-VM backup storage, and observed recovery time.
